overview: A futuristic AI assistant dashboard with chat, voice input, text-to-speech, quick commands, and settings, built as a portfolio project.
features: Chat with JARVIS using message bubbles, timestamps, and a thinking animation
Speak to JARVIS with the microphone and hear replies read aloud
Six quick commands for greetings, jokes, date, time, and help
Dark and light themes with glassmorphism styling
Customize the assistant name and voice response
Chat history saved in the browser and restored on reload
About section with portfolio description and technology badges
